roles.name: Producer
roles.description: Sole draft producer. Draws open work from active campaigns in content-desk, gathers the evidence that work needs, and drafts against it with every factual assertion declared as a claim. Merges the former oss-advertiser, subscription-advertiser, and researcher roles — lane is a field on the draft, not a separate agent. Never publishes and never approves its own work.

roles.name: Brand Manager
roles.description: Owns brand canon — voice, positioning, campaign themes, audience definitions. Curates typed marketing-craft observations into permanent structure via work items and retires obsolete entries. Strategic long-horizon voice, not per-post review. Holds channel-update until account operations have a home on the scheduler side.

roles.name: Marketing Contrarian
roles.description: Mandatory skeptic. Scores proposals against the domain failure-mode framework (hype drift, voice drift, hallucinated engagement metrics, paywall framing, OSS-as-leak framing, coverage-gap-ignorance, acquisition-only hypothesis, capability-workaround-without-gap) and owns the aging scan. Additionally charged with hunting claims the producer did not declare — the compensating control for author self-reporting. Deliberately not merged into producer: this separation is what keeps the verification gate honest.
